I’m Nasrin, a BCA graduate and MCA student at MES College of Engineering, Kuttippuram. I work with Python, Django, and Flask to turn complex processes into clear, usable web applications.

My interests sit at the intersection of software development and IT project delivery. Alongside academic projects, my work in student registration and online tutoring has strengthened how I communicate, coordinate, and solve problems with people.
